Track Length.reason: 5,513 m (official lap length) / 1,609.344 = 3.426 miles; the game stores miles (CircuitManager.cs:46). The traced centreline measures 5503 m.

Safety Car Flag Chance.reason: Phoenix is 0.50. COTA has had a safety car in roughly 4 of its ~11 races (about 0.35 from memory of the race history, not fetched), and lap-1 turn-1 incidents are the usual cause; 0.4 keeps it a little under Phoenix. Override in the manifest.

Virtual Safety Car Chance.reason: Phoenix is 0.00 and the Locations table was not available offline to compare other rows. the wide asphalt run-offs at COTA mean many incidents are cleared under a VSC rather than a full safety car, so a modest 0.3 (below the 0.4 safety car chance). Override in the manifest.

Track Rubber Modifier.reason: Neutral 1.0, same as Phoenix. Nothing in the open data says COTA rubbers in faster or slower than a typical permanent circuit.

Minimap Rotation.reason: The minimap sprite is generated north-up in pack-local x/z, so no rotation is needed (MinimapWidget.cs:187 adds minimapRotation to the finish-line angle).

Minimap Axis.reason: Axis "x" maps the sprite width to world x and its height to world z (MinimapWidget.SetTrackDimensions, MinimapWidget.cs:161-173); the pack frame is x = east, z = north.

TS.reason: Neutral weight is 4 (Car.cs:327). The longest straight measures 1125 m on the traced centreline (the ~1.2 km back straight; the pit straight is 415, 320 m): 4 x 1125/900 = 5.0, rounded to 5.

ACC.reason: Neutral 4 = one third of the corners being low-speed. The corner-finder emulator finds 22 corners, 8 of them Low (T1, T11, T12 hairpins and the stadium section), so traction exits matter about as much as average: 4 x 8/7.3 = 4.4 -> 4.

DEC.reason: Braking weight counts hard stops: corners entered after a straight of at least 250 m. The emulator finds 5 (T1, the T11 hairpin after the 1.2 km straight, T12 and others); 4 x 5/5 = 4.0 -> 4 (5 such zones taken as neutral).

HSC.reason: The three corner weights share a total of 12 (neutral 4 each) in proportion to corner length by emulated speed class: high-speed corners are 48% of corner length (11 corners including the flowing T3-T6 esses and T17-T18): 12 x 0.48 = 5.8 -> 6.

MSC.reason: The three corner weights share a total of 12 (neutral 4 each) in proportion to corner length by emulated speed class: medium-speed corners are 18% of corner length (3 corners): 12 x 0.18 = 2.2 -> 2.

LSC.reason: The three corner weights share a total of 12 (neutral 4 each) in proportion to corner length by emulated speed class: low-speed corners are 33% of corner length (8 corners): 12 x 0.33 = 4.0 -> 4.

First Tyre Option.reason: The softest of the three compounds on offer; COTA is a medium-to-high energy track with a hot Texas climate, so the softest option is Soft (not SuperSoft). Same first option as Phoenix.

Second Tyre Option.reason: Middle compound, the usual race-day workhorse.

Third Tyre Option.reason: Hardest compound the game offers. COTA is abrasive with sustained lateral loads through the esses, which favours the harder end of the range.

Tyre Wear Rate.reason: Phoenix is Low. the sustained high-speed lateral loading at COTA (the T3-T6 esses and the fast T16-T18 complex) and abrasive surface make tyre wear above average for a permanent circuit: High.

Fuel Burn Rate.reason: A 5.5 km lap with 34% of its length on straights over 250 m is slightly fuel-hungry per lap, but the game scales burn by lap length already; Medium, same as Phoenix.

Travel Cost.reason: Millions, same scale as the Locations table. Phoenix, the other US venue, is 0.075 (75,000, scene-Phoenix.txt CIRCUIT DATA ROW); both are US venues so the same value is used.

notes: Cars often run wide at T1 on lap 1.
The back straight is about 1.2 km.
Real T1 colours: red/white kerbs, red-white-blue striped painted run-off, a very wide T1 apron.
